faqs.answer: Ayush has about 9 years of experience spanning civil engineering, business analysis, and AI product roles. He now focuses on Applied AI / GenAI product management.
Ayush builds RAG systems with retrieval pipelines and FAISS — notably Neo (Flask + FAISS + Gemini/OpenAI fallback) and production semantic retrieval at Verifast.

Ayush specialises in agentic AI product work — intent detection, tool/action orchestration, semantic retrieval, and business-rule guardrails. He applied this in production at Verifast (600+ e-commerce clients) and in hands-on builds with LangGraph, Neo RAG, and AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

Ayush works hands-on with Python and Flask for AI assistants (Neo RAG, agent frameworks), plus Excel modeling and Jira for delivery. His stack emphasis is agentic systems: LangGraph, RAG/FAISS, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, and Gemini/OpenAI integrations.
Ayush is based in Durham, UK, while completing his Full-Time MBA at Durham University Business School (expected September 2026).

At Verifast, Ayush worked on an agentic AI sales platform for 600+ e-commerce clients. He owned architecture (intent, orchestration, retrieval, guardrails) and fixed a production flash-sale incident where stale grounding data caused wrong price/stock answers — root cause was batch sync interval vs real-time updates.

At CGI on Bell Canada projects, Ayush moved from Business System Analyst to Associate PM on a GenAI pilot. He structured use cases, defined success metrics, and delivered a customer enquiry automation platform in roughly 4 months.

Ayush is completing a Full-Time MBA at Durham University Business School, specialising in Consulting, Strategy, and AI, expected September 2026. Consulting work includes Salud.ai, BP board strategy, and V-Lab advisory.
Salud.ai sprint: co-founded Durham MBA consultancy for a US freemium health app — GTM strategy, AI/data strategy, KPIs, and client presentation.

BP board strategy case: asset divestment analysis, IEMS for data centres (Lightsource BP + gas + Castrol cooling), four-pillar AI transformation strategy, and a Geopolitical Intelligence Unit recommendation. Deliverables included PowerPoint, Excel models, Word appendices, and boardroom speech notes.
V-Lab advisory: market entry for India/China/Australia in wind energy VR training, TAM/SAM/SOM modeling, and six agentic AI service concepts built on digital shadow data.
Ayush builds agentic systems with LangGraph, RAG, retrieval pipelines, and guardrails — hands-on with Neo (Flask+FAISS), Verifast production platform, and AWS Bedrock AgentCore.
Neo is Ayush's personal RAG AI assistant — Flask + FAISS with Gemini/OpenAI fallback and multi-tenant support. He built it chapter-by-chapter; the portfolio chatbot uses the same KB-first pattern.
Finbot is an investment advice chatbot Ayush built on BharatGPT, assembled sequentially component-by-component rather than as a one-shot demo.
Ayush has hands-on AWS Bedrock AgentCore + LangGraph deployment experience for interview readiness, plus MyAgentcore — a custom framework for building and deploying AI agents.
Ayush studied Salesforce Agentforce and Data Cloud on Trailhead (Topics/Actions, DMOs, identity resolution) and mapped those patterns to Verifast's agentic architecture.
Ayush runs an AI video content pipeline: ChatGPT scripts, Minimax/Imagine video, Midjourney images, Shotcut editing — covering Indian history/culture and youth comedy/lifestyle content.
Technical projects include Neo (RAG assistant), Finbot (investment chatbot), AWS Bedrock AgentCore + LangGraph, Salesforce Agentforce/Data Cloud study, AI video pipeline, and MyAgentcore.
Ayush is a certified SAFe Agile professional with experience driving agile transformation at CGI and delivering AI products in structured iterations.
Ayush is pursuing Applied AI / GenAI Product Manager and consulting-strategy roles. MBA completing Sep 2026. Connect via LinkedIn or the Contact section.
DKPR E-Learn is an early-career e-learning role — detailed contributions are being added to the portfolio. Ask about Verifast, CGI, or Durham consulting for recent work.
